caseName: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission v. Martin Exploration Management Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission v. Martin Exploration Management Co. and Public Service Commission of the State of New York v. Martin Exploration Management Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 10th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 962.] Motions of Interstate Natural Gas Association of America and Williams Natural Gas Co. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument granted.

Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
